records.summary: Podio provides a broad RESTful JSON API to free and paid accounts and operates a remote MCP server at https://mcp.podio.com/mcp. The MCP server is in beta and supports Podio account OAuth sign-in or a dedicated Podio API key configured as OAuth client credentials.
records.blocker: MCP is beta and the shared default credentials are limited to approximately 30-40 test requests; production use should use a dedicated Podio API key. REST remains available to free accounts within base rate limits unless an API add-on is purchased.
records.next_action: For MCP, connect an MCP-compatible client to https://mcp.podio.com/mcp, authorize with a Podio account for evaluation, and create a dedicated Podio API key with redirect URL https://mcp.podio.com for production-oriented testing. Continue using OAuth2/app authentication for direct REST integration.

records.summary: Waterfall.io is Waterfall Data's B2B contact and company enrichment REST API. It uses x-api-key authentication, requires reviewed approval and contract access, and documents direct HTTP Agent Skills rather than an MCP server.
